# VP Recent-Sequence Cascade

> A coupled Flood → Glaciation → Atlantic-Opening relaxation on a jammed-water (VP) substrate, presented as a physically-permitted, occurrence-open hypothesis. It asks whether one release of a jammed deep-water reservoir can drive all three as a single relaxation that measured constants and the VP jamming engine permit — and never asserts the sequence occurred. Every past-occurrence statement is capped [O] (open) in both directions by a constitutional firewall. Grades: [F] forced > [V] verified > [L] leaning > [O] open. Determinism: SEED=19, double-SHA-256, no parameter tuning (γ is measured, never fitted). Author: Young Jae Lee (ORCID 0009-0002-7535-8245). License: CC BY 4.0. Inherits VP physics (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17932566) and geodynamics (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.17978934). Concept DOI (cite this volume): 10.5281/zenodo.20827806.

## Chapters
- The 42 numbered chapters (modules/12…53) and 5 named modules build the cascade in order: reservoir anchor and no-go screens (12–15), single-relaxation theory and energy ledger (16–17), coupling evidence and distinctiveness audit (18–20), inheritance integration (21–22, 45), fossil/record/archaeology reading (23–26, 32), the glaciation-driven petroleum strand (27–31, 33–44), and the closing discriminator / causal-ordering / kernel-consistency / stress-test seam (46–53). Full per-chapter URLs are in [sitemap.xml](https://jamming-physics.org/recent-sequence-cascade/sitemap.xml).
